# Magnolia By The Sea

> Intracoastal waterfront vacation home in Indian Rocks Beach, Florida, sleeping up to 10 (three king bedrooms plus a four-bunk room)

## Property Overview

Magnolia By The Sea is a professionally managed waterfront vacation home located on the Intracoastal Waterway in Indian Rocks Beach, Florida. The property sleeps 10 guests across 4 bedrooms and 3 bathrooms. It features a heated saltwater pool, private dock, rooftop deck, 2 kayaks, paddleboards, and an included 6-passenger golf cart for beach access. It is waterfront on the Intracoastal, not beachfront: the beach access at the end of 20th Avenue is about half a mile away (about 2 minutes by golf cart or roughly a 10-minute walk).

## Key Facts

- Location: Indian Rocks Beach, FL (Gulf Coast, Pinellas County)
- Bedrooms: 4 (Waterfront Balcony Room, Poolside Room, Private Retreat, Bunk Haven)
- Bathrooms: 3
- Sleeps: 10 guests maximum; ideal for 6 adults and 4 children
- Beds: 3 king beds + 4 Twin XL bunks
- Ratings (as of November 2026): Airbnb 5.0 from 48 reviews (Guest Favorite, top 10% of homes); Vrbo 10/10 from 12 reviews
- Reviews on this website: 67 written reviews from Airbnb, Vrbo, and direct stays
- Registration: BTR# 2302
- Property Manager: Florida Dreamscape Vacation Rentals

## Rooms

- Waterfront Balcony Room: King bed, private balcony overlooking the Intracoastal, access to rooftop deck
- Poolside Room: King bed, patio doors leading directly to the heated pool and backyard
- Private Retreat: King bed, vaulted ceiling, ensuite access to upstairs bathroom
- Bunk Haven: 4 custom built-in Twin XL bunk beds with USB outlets and personal LED lights

## Amenities

- Heated saltwater pool (year-round)
- Private dock with direct Intracoastal access
- 2 kayaks with kayak launch, plus paddleboards
- 6-passenger golf cart (included)
- Rooftop deck
- Ground-level fire pit by the water
- Tesla EV charger
- 1Gbps WiFi
- Nespresso machine
- Weber grill and outdoor dining
- Covered outdoor dining area
- Outdoor shower
- Washer and dryer
- Pack and play and high chair available

## Policies

- No pets allowed
- No smoking allowed
- Check-in: 4:00 PM, Check-out: 10:00 AM
- Primary renter must be 21 or older
- Minimum stay: usually 3 nights
- Cancellation: terms depend on where and when you book; the exact policy is shown before you confirm

## Parking & Access

- Large circular driveway fits 4-5 cars
- Golf cart has its own parking spot at the house; golf cart parking at the beach accesses is public and first come, first served
- Golf cart drivers must be 18+ with a valid license
- Three levels connected by stairs: ground level is 3 steps down from the main level; two bedrooms are upstairs; the rooftop deck is reached by a spiral staircase

## Seasonality

- Busiest months: March through August
- Best weather: October and November
- Thanksgiving, Christmas, and New Year's often book far in advance

## Distances

- Beach access at the end of 20th Avenue: about half a mile; about 2 minutes by golf cart or roughly a 10-minute walk
- Drive times below assume light traffic
- St. Pete-Clearwater International Airport (PIE): about 25 minutes
- Tampa International Airport: about 40 to 50 minutes
- Clearwater Downtown: about 15 to 20 minutes
- Clearwater Marine Aquarium: about 7.5 miles, 15 to 20 minutes
- Downtown St. Petersburg: about 35 to 45 minutes
- Busch Gardens Tampa Bay: about 1 hour
- Publix supermarket: 5 minutes by car
- Walmart and Target: 10 minutes by car
